2	name: everything-search
3	description: Search files and folders instantly across Windows drives or within specific project paths using Everything (HTTP REST API or es.exe CLI). Supports sandboxed agents (Docker, WSL, DevContainers) and native desktop environments with automatic dual-mode fallback.
4	---
5	
6	# Everything Search (Dual-Mode: HTTP REST API & CLI)
7	
8	Ultra-fast, index-powered local file search using Voidtools Everything.
9	Supports both **HTTP REST API mode** (essential for sandboxed/containerized agents like Docker, WSL, DevContainers) and **native CLI mode** (`es.exe` Win32 IPC) with automatic fallback.
10	
11	---
12	
13	## Why Dual-Mode? (Solving Sandboxed Agent IPC Issues)
14	
15	When an AI agent runs inside a **sandbox**, **Docker container**, **WSL2**, or a **Session 0 background service**, calling `es.exe` directly often fails with:
16	`Error 8: Everything IPC window not found. Please make sure Everything is running.`
17	
18	**Root Cause**: Windows enforces User Interface Privilege Isolation (UIPI) and Session Isolation. Sandboxed processes and non-interactive sessions cannot send Win32 `WM_COPYDATA` window messages to the host desktop session.
19	
20	**The Solution**:
21	Everything provides a high-performance built-in **HTTP REST API**. Network calls (TCP) bypass Win32 UIPI/session isolation entirely:
22	- **Sandboxed Agent / Container** ➡️ HTTP Request (`http://host.docker.internal:8080`) ➡️ Host Everything Index (Instant Results!)
23	- **Native Desktop Session** ➡️ Automatic fallback to `es.exe` CLI if HTTP is disabled.
24	
25	---
26	
27	## When to Use This Skill
28	
29	Use this skill whenever you need to:
30	- Locate files or directories instantly across local drives or inside a project directory
31	- Search files in sandboxed environments (Docker, WSL, restricted agents) without IPC errors
32	- Filter by name pattern, extension (`ext:ts;tsx`), size (`size:>100MB`), or date modified (`dm:today`)
33	- Output structured JSON for automated pipelines without token-costly directory walks
34	
35	---
36	
37	## Quick Start: Python Dual-Mode Helper (Recommended)
38	
39	The skill includes `scripts/everything_search.py`, which uses **only Python standard libraries** (zero external dependencies like `requests`).
40	
41	```bash
42	# Auto mode: Attempts HTTP on port 8080 first; falls back to es.exe CLI automatically
43	python scripts/everything_search.py "package.json" -n 20
44	
45	# Structured JSON output
46	python scripts/everything_search.py "ext:py model" -n 10 --json
47	
48	# Restrict search to a specific directory
49	python scripts/everything_search.py "main.go" -p "C:\MyProject" -n 5
50	
51	# Explicitly force HTTP REST mode
52	python scripts/everything_search.py "exact:Dockerfile" --mode http
53	
54	# Specify custom host/port (e.g. from Docker container to host)
55	python scripts/everything_search.py "*.json" --url "http://host.docker.internal:8080" -n 10
56	```
57	
58	---
59	
60	## Sandboxed & Container Environment Configuration
61	
62	### 1. Enable HTTP Server on Windows Host (One-time Setup)
63	In Everything on the host machine:
64	1. Open Everything -> **Tools** (工具) -> **Options** (选项).
65	2. Click **HTTP Server** (HTTP 服务器) in the left menu.
66	3. Check **Enable HTTP Server** (启用 HTTP 服务器), set Port to `8080`, and click OK.
67	*(Optional: run `scripts/enable_http.ps1` to configure automatically).*
68	
69	### 2. Connect from Docker Container
70	Run your Docker container with host access:
71	```bash
72	docker run -e EVERYTHING_HTTP_URL=http://host.docker.internal:8080 --add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway ...
73	```
74	Inside the container:
75	```python
76	python scripts/everything_search.py "ext:rs" -n 10 --json
77	```
78	
79	### 3. Connect from WSL2
80	Inside WSL, resolve the Windows host IP:
81	```bash
82	export EVERYTHING_HTTP_URL="http://$(ip route show | awk '/default/ {print $3}'):8080"
83	python3 scripts/everything_search.py "ext:md" -n 10
84	```
85	
86	---
87	
88	## Direct CLI Usage (`es.exe` for Native Desktop Sessions)
89	
90	When running directly in a native Windows user desktop session:
91	
92	```powershell
93	# Basic search (ALWAYS specify -n to prevent flooding LLM context)
94	es.exe -n 20 "settings.json"
95	
96	# Search inside project folder
97	es.exe -path "C:\my-repo" -n 20 "index.ts"
98	
99	# Files only (/a-d) or Folders only (/ad)
100	es.exe /a-d -n 15 "ext:tsx component"
101	es.exe /ad -n 10 "node_modules"
102	
103	# Sort by date modified (newest first)
104	es.exe -sort-date-modified-descending -n 10 "ext:log dm:today"
105	```
106	
107	---
108	
109	## Everything Search Syntax Cheatsheet
110	
111	| Filter | Syntax | Example |
112	|---|---|---|
113	| Multiple extensions | `ext:<ext1;ext2>` | `ext:md;txt;json` |
114	| File size | `size:>100MB` or `size:1MB..10MB` | `size:>500MB /a-d` |
115	| Date modified | `dm:<time>` | `dm:today`, `dm:last7days`, `dm:2025` |
116	| Exact match | `exact:<name>` | `exact:Dockerfile` |
117	| Logical AND | `space` | `auth controller ext:go` |
118	| Logical OR | `|` (with spaces) | `*.jpg | *.png` |
119	| Logical NOT | `!` | `*.ts !*.test.ts` |
120	| Regex search | `-r` flag | `es.exe -r "src\\api\\.*\.go$"` |
121	
122	---
123	
124	## Environment Variables
125	
126	| Variable | Default | Purpose |
127	|---|---|---|
128	| `EVERYTHING_HTTP_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:8080` | URL of Everything HTTP service |
129	| `EVERYTHING_HTTP_USER` | `""` | Optional Basic Auth username |
130	| `EVERYTHING_HTTP_PASS` | `""` | Optional Basic Auth password |
